annotations.title: Get a re-test quote for a reviewed service (free quote, paid re-test)

description: Get an upfront quote for UseTested to re-test a service we have already reviewed — e.g. its quality changed, the review is stale, or measured numbers no longer match reality. Free. Returns the exact total: $1.00 rubric fee + the service's current advertised per-call price x 10 probe calls. To proceed, pay the quote via accept_retest_quote. The service must exist in our directory (find the exact name via search_services, free).

reason.description: Why a re-test is needed (changed behaviour, stale data, errors)

service_name.description: Exact service name, as listed by search_services (free)
